"""Main applies reviewed diagnostics in an isolated worktree and builds both modes."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import time
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
BASE = G / '.worktree/diag-cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012'
W = G / '.worktree/diag-native-grouped-event-20261012'
X = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011')
T = X / '.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install'
L = X / '.lint'
GGML = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('grouped_event_build_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(T / 'bin') + ':' + str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin',
           HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
           LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(T / 'lib') + ':/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1/lib',
           MKLROOT='/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')


def ident(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-native-grouped-event-build-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not W.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], source=ident(Path(__file__)),
             gpu_executed=False, source_pins={}, builds={})

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    started = time.monotonic()

    def run(label, argv, cwd=BASE, wall=180, allowed=(0,)):
        left = 5400 - (time.monotonic() - started)
        assert left > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=min(wall, left), cpu=wall * 6,
                             rss_cap=24 << 30, text_cap=16 << 20,
                             total_cap=128 << 20, file_cap=256 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed
        print('CLOSED ' + label + ' exit=' + str(c['exit_code']), flush=True)
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('base-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == 'd787a19b20c023dbcc2d1d05b404340465f9b895'
        assert not run('base-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        run('create-worktree', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'add', '-b', 'diag/native-grouped-event-20261012', str(W), 'HEAD'])
        assert str(W) in run('worktrees', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'list'])
        assert (W / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes() == (BASE / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes()
        for version in [1, 2, 3]:
            packet = B / ('implementation-native-grouped-gemm-event-bench-source-v' + str(version))
            manifest = json.loads((packet / 'manifest.json').read_text())
            r.setdefault('packets', {})[str(version)] = ident(packet / 'manifest.json')
            for name, pin in manifest['files'].items():
                if version == 1 and name == 'CMakeLists.txt':
                    continue  # Preserve Main's CPU CMake additions; apply only the reviewed diagnostic hunk.
                if version > 1 and not pin.get('changed', True):
                    continue
                target = W / name
                before = pin['before_sha256']
                assert (not target.exists()) if before is None else m.sha(target) == before
            run('patch-check-v' + str(version), ['/usr/bin/git', 'apply', '--check', str(packet / 'changes.patch')], W)
            run('patch-v' + str(version), ['/usr/bin/git', 'apply', str(packet / 'changes.patch')], W)
        p = W / 'include/strata/kernels/grouped_gemm_diagnostic.hpp'
        s = p.read_text().replace('    int groups;\n    int64_t max_rows, n, k;\n    int tile_m, tile_n, pipeline;',
                                  '    int64_t max_rows, n, k;\n    int groups, tile_m, tile_n, pipeline;')
        p.write_text(s)
        p = W / 'src/kernels/xe/xmx_gemm.cpp'
        s = p.read_text().replace('"joint_matrix", G, max_rows, N, K, 0, 0, 0}',
                                  '"joint_matrix", max_rows, N, K, G, 0, 0, 0}').replace(
                                  '"DP4a", G, max_rows, N, K, 0, 0, 0}',
                                  '"DP4a", max_rows, N, K, G, 0, 0, 0}').replace(
                                  '{event, "XMX", G, max_rows, N, K, WM, WN, PD}',
                                  '{event, "XMX", max_rows, N, K, G, WM, WN, PD}')
        p.write_text(s)
        p = W / 'tools/native_grouped_gemm_event_bench.cpp'
        s = p.read_text().replace('if (std::memcmp(host_bounds, validation_scratch, sizeof(host_bounds)))',
                                  'if (std::memcmp(host_bounds, validation_scratch, sizeof(host_bounds)) != 0)')
        anchor = '        if (bounds) sycl::free(bounds, q);'
        assert s.count(anchor) == 1
        s = s.replace(anchor, '        if (async_error.load()) {\n'
                             '            std::fprintf(stderr, "asynchronous failure; fail-stop without freeing uncertain GPU state\\n");\n'
                             '            std::_Exit(1);\n'
                             '        }\n' + anchor)
        p.write_text(s)
        r['main_adjustments'] = ['Avoid padding in new diagnostic return struct; aggregate initializers updated.',
                                'Explicit memcmp integer comparison.',
                                'Async error latch fail-stops even if handler consumed the queue exception; no free after uncertain completion.']
        names = ['CMakeLists.txt', 'include/strata/kernels/grouped_gemm_diagnostic.hpp',
                 'src/kernels/xe/xmx_gemm.cpp', 'tools/native_grouped_gemm_event_bench.cpp']
        r['source_pins'] = {name: m.sha(W / name) for name in names}
        r['source_review'] = dict(full_source_review=True, no_new_kernel_body=True,
                                 device_bounds_actual_checked_D2H=True, positive_exact_event_guard=True,
                                 owner_lifetimes_reviewed=True, no_gpu_qualification_yet=True)
        save()
        tar = G / '.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012/build/contrib-llvm/_deps/strata_onemath-subbuild/strata_onemath-populate-prefix/src/xestrata-3.tar.gz'
        assert tar.is_file()
        r['compiler'] = ident(T / 'bin/clang++')
        r['dependency_archive'] = ident(tar)
        for mode, license in [('free', 'free'), ('contrib-llvm', 'contrib')]:
            build = W / 'build' / mode
            argv = ['/usr/bin/cmake', '-S', str(W), '-B', str(build), '-G', 'Ninja',
                    '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release', '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang++'),
                    '-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang'), '-DSTRATA_LICENSE=' + license,
                    '-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=ON', '-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=',
                    '-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=' + ('ON' if mode == 'contrib-llvm' else 'OFF'),
                    '-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF', '-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON', '-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON',
                    '-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=' + str(GGML), '-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON']
            if mode == 'contrib-llvm':
                argv += ['-DSTRATA_ONEMATH_SOURCE=' + tar.as_uri(), '-DMKL_ROOT=/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1']
            run('configure-' + mode, argv, W, wall=300)
            run('build-' + mode, ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(build), '--parallel', '4',
                                  '--target', 'strata', 'native_grouped_gemm_event_bench'], W, wall=1700)
            r['builds'][mode] = dict(binary=ident(build / 'strata'), diagnostic=ident(build / 'native_grouped_gemm_event_bench'),
                                    cache=ident(build / 'CMakeCache.txt'), compile_db=ident(build / 'compile_commands.json'),
                                    runtime_tested=False)
            for index, args in enumerate([[], ['gu', '0'], ['down', '513'], ['invalid', '128']], 1):
                run('cpu-cli-' + mode + '-' + str(index), [str(build / 'native_grouped_gemm_event_bench'), *args], W,
                    wall=30, allowed=(2,))
            save()
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == pin for name, pin in r['source_pins'].items())
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r.update(error=repr(error), traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'complete')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
